items.title: Verisk’s (NASDAQ:VRSK) Q3 2026 earnings results: revenue in line with expectations
items.summary: Insurance data analytics provider Verisk Analytics (NASDAQ:VRSK) met Wall Street’s revenue expectations in Q3 2026, with revenue up 5.3% year on year to $809 million. The company’s outlook for the full year was close to analysts’ consensus estimates, with revenue guided to $3.22 billion at the midpoint. Its non-GAAP profit of $1.96 per share was 2% above analysts’ consensus estimates.
